name: 読書モードの小さな設定
prompt:
Create one isolated high-resolution Japanese reading-settings popover UI, not a full phone screenshot. Use reference 1 ORIGINAL Brave Browser screenshot as PRIMARY authority for control anatomy, icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical weight, alignment and fine spacing. Use reference 2 saved Japanese mock only as SECONDARY content/layout guidance; it has rough icons and omissions. Reference 3 is official Lighthouse finish only; do not copy its bus subject.
Scope is the popover region x311 y314 width825 height605 in original 1179x2676. Preserve original rounded rectangle proportions, approximately 1.36:1 width:height, and restore its short triangular pointer near the top-right edge. Center on a pure white canvas with compact margins. The panel, header and all ordinary control surfaces must be pure white, with a fine neutral outline, subtle dividers and restrained shadow, no gray panel wash or mint.
Use Japanese labels from native mock exactly: header left 「標準」 muted neutral, right 「本文」 dark active; Meiryo Regular12 line16, letter spacing0. Below divider, three evenly distributed labels 「小」 Meiryo Regular14/24, 「あ」 Meiryo Regular20/28, 「大」 Meiryo Regular14/24, all regular light optical weight, no bold.
Four circular theme swatches: white, warm sepia cream, dark gray, black. The SECOND sepia swatch is selected; retain its warm cream fill from ORIGINAL, remove mock mint. Selected ring uses official forest green #1F6444 instead of original purple. Evenly space circles and match original ring proportions.
Bottom brightness control: a SMALL hollow eight-ray sun on left and a distinctly LARGER filled-center eight-ray sun on right, exactly match original optical silhouettes; color both coherent slate #526173. Do not use the mock's identical flower-like symbols. Neutral pale-gray narrow track with active forest gradient #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E; white circular thumb with very restrained shadow at approximately62% from left, as ORIGINAL, not mock40%. The ring and active track are functional selected-state controls, adapted to official primary forest. Keep black/dark-gray/cream swatch colors because they demonstrate actual reading themes.
No screen title, toolbar, document text, browser chrome, English words, extra captions, annotations or branding. Clean flat polished raster UI, accessible type, exact Japanese characters. Preserve compact readable hierarchy and original control geometry. Static visual concept only.
reviewNotes: Original-control-detail hierarchy applied. Inspected output: white panel and restored pointer, exact Japanese labels, cream selected theme, distinct hollow small/filled large slate suns, slider approximately62%, forest selected controls. No extra chrome. Regular type intended; exact native font metrics and actions remain unproven. Agent raster visual review only, no owner/native/application acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
